concerns.text: Task T042 adds a data‑manifest generation step with “real‑data fallback logic”. The spec (FR‑001, FR‑006) and Constitution Principle VI explicitly forbid synthetic substitution for scientific runs; the pipeline must halt if real multi‑omics data are unavailable. Allowing a fallback to synthetic data weakens the functional requirement and violates the constitution.

The Success Criteria SC‑001, SC‑002, and SC‑003 are not explicitly verified by any task. No task checks that cross‑validated performance ≥ 75 % (SC‑001), that ≥ 10 SNPs and ≥ 10 metabolites remain significant after the sensitivity sweep (SC‑002), or that the permutation p‑value ≤ 0.05 (SC‑003). Without dedicated verification tasks, the acceptance criteria are effectively dropped, constituting a requirement violation.
